title: Reading Drill — Testing temporary path closures — A pilot study
description: One short passage, six questions. Recommended time: 10 minutes.

passages.title: Testing temporary path closures — A pilot study
passages.body:
**A** A project in Brackenton began with reports of walkers following an old path when repairs begin. The park planner had heard several complaints, but individual reports could not show how often the problem occurred. The team collected evidence using site observations and chose entries onto closed paths as its main measure. That allowed it to compare different days using the same rule.

**B** The proposed response was paired notices at junctions. Rather than apply it immediately across the whole site, the team ran a trial in a single area. The trial lasted nine weeks. A second area kept its previous arrangements, making it possible to see whether any change occurred at both sites.

**C** The first review recorded walking events as a factor that could affect the comparison. The team advised repeating the study under different conditions before drawing a wider conclusion. It kept the evidence from the first trial but published a note about why the figures might not apply elsewhere.
